name: Goa
tagline: Beaches, Portuguese lanes and long sunsets
getting_there: Fly into Dabolim (south) or Mopa (north), or take a train to Madgaon / Thivim.
getting_around: Rent a scooter (carry your driving licence) or use GoaMiles taxis. Buses are cheap but slow.

hotel_areas.best_for: First trip, nightlife, lots of options
hotel_areas.note: Busy and noisy in peak season.
Good for groups of friends on a budget.

hotel_areas.best_for: Central base for Old Goa and Fontainhas

hotel_areas.note: Far from the north Goa sights.

tips: Drinking alcohol on beaches and in public places is banned and fined.
Swim only where lifeguards have flagged safe zones. The sea is rough from June to September.
Wear a helmet and carry your licence if you rent a scooter. Police checks are common.
Cover shoulders and knees inside churches.
Bargain at flea markets. Start at about half the quoted price.
dont_miss: Sunset from Chapora Fort
A walk through the coloured houses of Fontainhas
Goan fish curry rice at a beach shack
A night market in season (roughly November to April)

attractions.name: Baga & Calangute Beach
attractions.description: Goa's busiest beach strip with water sports by day and shacks by night.

attractions.name: Fort Aguada
attractions.description: A 17th-century Portuguese fort and lighthouse above the sea.

attractions.name: Chapora Fort
attractions.description: Ruined fort on a hill with one of the best sunset views in Goa.

attractions.name: Anjuna Flea Market
attractions.description: Wednesday market for clothes, jewellery and souvenirs, mostly in the tourist season.

attractions.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus & Old Goa
attractions.description: UNESCO-listed churches from the Portuguese era, including the Basilica of Bom Jesus.

attractions.name: Fontainhas Latin Quarter
attractions.description: Narrow lanes of colourful Portuguese-style houses, bakeries and small cafes.

attractions.name: Mandovi River Cruise
attractions.description: An evening boat ride on the Mandovi with folk music and dance.

attractions.name: Spice Plantation Tour
attractions.description: Guided walk through a spice farm, usually with a Goan buffet lunch.

attractions.name: Dudhsagar Falls
attractions.description: A tall four-tier waterfall reached by jeep through the forest.
attractions.tip: Jeep trips usually stop in peak monsoon. Check before going.

attractions.name: Palolem Beach
attractions.description: A calm crescent-shaped beach in South Goa, good for kayaking.

name: Hyderabad
tagline: Nizami heritage, biryani and old-city bazaars
getting_there: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, or trains to Secunderabad, Nampally and Kacheguda.
getting_around: Hyderabad Metro covers the main corridors. Use autos or app cabs for the old city.

hotel_areas.best_for: Budget stays close to the old city
Good restaurants, mid to premium hotels

tips: Salar Jung Museum and Chowmahalla Palace are closed on Fridays.
Visit Charminar early in the morning before the crowds and heat.
Phones and cameras are not allowed inside Birla Mandir. Leave them in the car or at the counter.
Dress modestly at Mecca Masjid and temples.
Haleem is a Ramzan-season speciality. Outside that month you will mostly find biryani.
dont_miss: A proper Hyderabadi biryani
Irani chai and Osmania biscuits in the old city
Light and sound show at Golconda Fort
Bangle shopping in Laad Bazaar

attractions.name: Charminar
attractions.description: The 16th-century monument at the heart of the old city.

attractions.name: Laad Bazaar
attractions.description: Old market famous for lac bangles, pearls and wedding shopping.

attractions.name: Chowmahalla Palace
attractions.description: The Nizams' palace complex with courtyards, halls and vintage cars.

attractions.name: Salar Jung Museum
attractions.description: One of India's largest single-collection museums, home to the Veiled Rebecca.

attractions.name: Golconda Fort
attractions.description: A huge hilltop fort with famous acoustics. Stay for the evening light and sound show.

attractions.name: Qutb Shahi Tombs
attractions.description: Restored domed tombs of the Qutb Shahi kings in a quiet garden.

attractions.name: Hussain Sagar & Tank Bund
attractions.description: Lake with the Buddha statue. Take a boat ride or walk along Necklace Road.

attractions.name: Birla Mandir
attractions.description: White marble temple on a hill with city views at dusk.

attractions.name: Ramoji Film City
attractions.description: A massive film studio complex with sets, shows and rides. Needs a full day.

attractions.name: Old City Food Walk
attractions.description: Irani cafes, kebabs, biryani and sweets around Charminar and Madina.

name: Jaipur
tagline: Forts, pink bazaars and royal palaces
getting_there: Jaipur International Airport, or trains to Jaipur Junction.
getting_around: Hire a cab or auto for a full day. The Pink City bazaars are best on foot.

hotel_areas.note: Close to Amber Fort, far from shops.

tips: A composite ticket covers several monuments, including Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal and Jantar Mantar. It works out cheaper if you visit three or more.
Reach Amber Fort when it opens to beat the heat and the crowds.
Ignore touts offering gem deals. Gem resale scams are common.
Bargain in Johari and Bapu Bazaar. Start well below the first price.
Carry a cap and water. Afternoons are hot even in winter.
dont_miss: Hawa Mahal from a rooftop cafe opposite
Sunset over the city from Nahargarh Fort
Lassi on MI Road
Block-print and mojari shopping in the bazaars

attractions.name: Amber Fort
attractions.description: A hilltop fort-palace with mirror halls and wide courtyards.

attractions.name: Hawa Mahal
attractions.description: The Palace of Winds with 953 small windows. Best in morning light.

attractions.name: City Palace
attractions.description: Royal residence with museums, courtyards and the famous peacock gate.

attractions.name: Jantar Mantar
attractions.description: UNESCO-listed 18th-century observatory with giant stone instruments.

attractions.name: Nahargarh Fort
attractions.description: Fort on the ridge above the city, the classic Jaipur sunset spot.

attractions.name: Jal Mahal
attractions.description: A palace in the middle of Man Sagar lake. Viewed from the promenade.

attractions.name: Johari & Bapu Bazaar
attractions.description: Jewellery, textiles, mojaris and street snacks in the old city.

attractions.name: Albert Hall Museum
attractions.description: Indo-Saracenic museum building, beautifully lit after dark.

attractions.name: Patrika Gate
attractions.description: A brightly painted gateway that is popular for photos.

attractions.name: Chokhi Dhani
attractions.description: A Rajasthani village-style resort with folk shows and a big thali dinner.

name: Manali
tagline: Snow, pine forests and mountain cafes
getting_there: Overnight Volvo bus from Delhi or Chandigarh, or fly to Bhuntar (about 50 km away).
getting_around: Local taxi union cabs run on fixed rates. Walk around Old Manali and Mall Road.

hotel_areas.note: Short uphill walk from the main town.
Need a cab to get around.

tips: Rohtang Pass needs an online permit booked in advance and is closed on Tuesdays. It usually opens only from about May to November.
Roads beyond Solang can close after heavy snow. Check road status the night before.
Carry warm layers even in summer. Evenings get cold fast.
Carry some cash. ATMs and network get patchy as you go higher.
Don't litter. Fines apply in many areas.
dont_miss: Snow at Solang Valley or beyond the Atal Tunnel (season-dependent)
Hadimba Temple in the cedar forest
A slow evening at an Old Manali cafe
Siddu and local trout

attractions.name: Hadimba Temple
attractions.description: A 16th-century wooden pagoda-style temple inside a deodar forest.

attractions.name: Old Manali & Manu Temple
attractions.description: Village lanes with cafes, guesthouses and the old Manu Temple.

attractions.name: Mall Road
attractions.description: The main market street for woollens, shawls and street food.

attractions.name: Tibetan Monastery
attractions.description: Colourful Gadhan Thekchhokling Gompa near the bus stand.

attractions.name: Vashisht Hot Springs
attractions.description: Natural sulphur springs next to an old stone temple.

attractions.name: Jogini Waterfall Trek
attractions.description: An easy-to-moderate walk through orchards to a tall waterfall.

attractions.name: Solang Valley
attractions.description: Snow in winter, paragliding and ropeway rides the rest of the year.
attractions.tip: Activity prices vary a lot. Fix the price before you start.

attractions.name: Atal Tunnel & Sissu
attractions.description: Drive through the 9 km tunnel to snowy Lahaul valley and Sissu waterfall.

attractions.name: Rohtang Pass
attractions.description: A high mountain pass at about 3,980 m with snow for much of the year.

attractions.name: Naggar Castle
attractions.description: A stone-and-wood castle with valley views and the Roerich art gallery nearby.

airport.name: Kullu–Bhuntar
airport.note: Very few flights. Many people fly to Chandigarh (IXC) and take a bus.

transport.rail_note: Manali has no railway. Take a train to Chandigarh (CDG), then a bus or cab for about 8–10 hours.
transport.bus_note: Overnight Volvo buses run from Delhi and Chandigarh.

name: Bengaluru
tagline: Gardens, filter coffee and a big food scene
getting_there: Kempegowda International Airport (about an hour from the city), or trains to KSR Bengaluru.
getting_around: Namma Metro is the fastest way across the city. Use autos and app cabs for short hops.

hotel_areas.note: Traffic gets heavy in the evening.

tips: Plan by area. Avoid crossing the city between 8–11 am and 5–8 pm because of traffic.
Use the metro wherever it reaches. It saves a lot of time.
For Nandi Hills sunrise, leave by about 4:30 am. Weekends get very crowded.
Evenings in December and January can be cool. Carry a light jacket.
Many pubs close around 1 am. Check before planning a late night.
dont_miss: Masala dosa and filter coffee at an old darshini
A morning walk in Cubbon Park
VV Puram food street in the evening
Sunrise above the clouds at Nandi Hills

attractions.name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden
attractions.description: A 240-acre garden with a glass house and old trees.

attractions.name: Cubbon Park
attractions.description: Green lung of the city next to the State Central Library.

attractions.name: Vidhana Soudha
attractions.description: Karnataka's granite legislature building, viewed from outside.

attractions.name: Bangalore Palace
attractions.description: Tudor-style palace with royal interiors.

attractions.name: Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace
attractions.description: A two-storey teak palace from the 18th century.

attractions.name: ISKCON Temple
attractions.description: A large hilltop temple complex, lively during evening aarti.

attractions.name: VV Puram Food Street
attractions.description: A street of stalls for dosas, holige, gulkand and more.

attractions.name: Church Street & MG Road
attractions.description: Bookshops, cafes, pubs and street music in the city centre.

attractions.name: Commercial Street
attractions.description: Busy street for budget clothes, accessories and bargains.

attractions.name: Nandi Hills
attractions.description: A hill fort about 60 km away, famous for sunrise above the clouds.

name: Pondicherry
tagline: French lanes, calm seafronts and Auroville
getting_there: About 3 hours by road from Chennai. The nearest major airport is Chennai.
getting_around: Rent a scooter or a bicycle. White Town is best on foot.
tips: The Aurobindo Ashram asks for silence. Photos are not allowed inside.
To go inside the Matrimandir, book in advance at the Auroville visitor centre. Otherwise you can see it from the viewpoint.
The sea at Promenade (Rock) Beach is rough. Don't swim there.
Promenade Beach road is closed to vehicles in the evening, which makes it nice for a walk.
Rules for carrying alcohol into Tamil Nadu are strict. Check before you carry any across.
dont_miss: Sunrise walk on the Promenade
Cycling through White Town's yellow lanes
Paradise Beach by boat
A French bakery breakfast

attractions.name: Promenade (Rock) Beach
attractions.description: A 1.5 km seafront walk with the Gandhi statue and old lighthouse.

attractions.name: White Town Heritage Walk
attractions.description: Yellow French villas, bougainvillea and cafes in the old French quarter.

attractions.name: Sri Aurobindo Ashram
attractions.description: A quiet ashram with the flower-covered samadhi.

attractions.name: Basilica of the Sacred Heart
attractions.description: Gothic church with stained-glass panels.

attractions.name: Goubert Market
attractions.description: Local market for flowers, fruit, fish and spices.

attractions.name: Auroville & Matrimandir
attractions.description: An experimental township with the golden Matrimandir at its centre.

attractions.name: Paradise Beach
attractions.description: A clean sandy beach reached by a short backwater boat ride.

attractions.name: Serenity Beach
attractions.description: A quieter beach known for beginner surfing lessons.

attractions.name: Ousteri Lake
attractions.description: A wetland lake with migratory birds in winter and boating.

airport.name: Chennai
airport.note: Puducherry's own airport has very few flights. Most people fly to Chennai.

rail.name: Puducherry (PDY)
rail.note: Few direct trains. Villupuram (VM), 40 km away, has many more.

name: Rishikesh
tagline: Ganga aarti, yoga and white-water rafting
getting_there: Jolly Grant airport in Dehradun is about 35 km away. Trains and buses run to Haridwar and Rishikesh.
getting_around: Walk across the bridges. Shared autos run between town, Ram Jhula and Tapovan.

hotel_areas.best_for: Quiet ashram stays near Parmarth Niketan
Budget hotels near the bus stand

tips: Meat and alcohol are not served in Rishikesh's main areas. It's a vegetarian holy town.
Raft only with licensed operators and keep your life jacket on throughout.
Rafting usually pauses in July and August for the monsoon.
Don't swim at the ghats. The Ganga's current is stronger than it looks.
Dress modestly at ghats and temples. Watch out for monkeys grabbing bags.
dont_miss: Evening Ganga aarti at Parmarth Niketan
Rafting from Shivpuri in season
A yoga class in Tapovan
Sunrise at Kunjapuri temple

attractions.name: Ram Jhula & Swarg Ashram
attractions.description: Suspension bridge over the Ganga leading to old ashrams and ghats.
attractions.tip: Laxman Jhula was closed for safety in 2022. Check whether it or the new bridge is open.

attractions.name: Parmarth Niketan Ganga Aarti
attractions.description: Evening aarti with chanting and lamps on the river steps.

attractions.name: Triveni Ghat
attractions.description: The town's main bathing ghat with its own evening aarti.

attractions.name: River Rafting from Shivpuri
attractions.description: Around 16 km of rapids from Shivpuri back to Rishikesh.

attractions.name: Beatles Ashram (Chaurasi Kutia)
attractions.description: Abandoned ashram where the Beatles stayed in 1968, now covered in murals.

attractions.name: Neer Garh Waterfall
attractions.description: A short forest walk to a set of cascading pools.

attractions.name: Tapovan Cafes & Yoga
attractions.description: Drop-in yoga classes and riverside cafes with Ganga views.

attractions.name: Neelkanth Mahadev Temple
attractions.description: Shiva temple in the forested hills, a winding drive of about 30 km.

attractions.name: Kunjapuri Temple Sunrise
attractions.description: Hilltop temple with sunrise views over the Himalayan peaks.

rail.name: Haridwar (HW)
rail.note: Rishikesh (YNRK) also has some direct trains.

name: Varanasi
tagline: The ghats, the aarti and the old city lanes
getting_there: Lal Bahadur Shastri Airport, or trains to Varanasi Junction and Banaras station.
getting_around: Walk along the ghats and lanes, or take boats. E-rickshaws work for longer hops.

hotel_areas.best_for: Close to the main aarti and temple

tips: Agree on the boat price before you get in.
Phones and bags are not allowed inside Kashi Vishwanath Temple. Use the lockers nearby.
Don't photograph cremations at Manikarnika Ghat. Ignore anyone asking for wood donations.
Don't drink or bathe in the river water.
In the monsoon the ghats flood and boat rides may be stopped.
dont_miss: Ganga aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat
Sunrise boat ride along the ghats
Kachori sabzi breakfast and a Banarasi paan
Malaiyyo (only in winter)

attractions.name: Dashashwamedh Ganga Aarti
attractions.description: The grand evening aarti with priests, lamps and bells by the river.
attractions.tip: Reach 45 minutes early for a good spot, or watch from a boat.

attractions.name: Sunrise Boat Ride
attractions.description: Drift past the ghats as the city wakes up.

attractions.name: Assi Ghat Morning Aarti
attractions.description: Subah-e-Banaras: morning aarti, music and yoga at the southern ghat.

attractions.name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
attractions.description: One of the most important Shiva temples, with the new corridor to the river.

attractions.name: Manikarnika Ghat
attractions.description: The main cremation ghat. Observe quietly and respectfully.

attractions.name: Old City Food Walk
attractions.description: Kachoris, chaat, lassi and sweets through the narrow galis.

attractions.name: Sarnath
attractions.description: Where the Buddha gave his first sermon: Dhamek Stupa, ruins and museum.
attractions.tip: The site museum is closed on Fridays.

attractions.name: Ramnagar Fort
attractions.description: 18th-century fort of the Maharaja of Benares across the river.

attractions.name: BHU & New Vishwanath Temple
attractions.description: Leafy university campus with a tall marble temple and an art museum.

attractions.name: Banarasi Silk Weaving Visit
attractions.description: See handloom weavers at work and shop for Banarasi saris.
attractions.tip: Go with your own budget in mind. Guides often earn commission here.

name: Darjeeling
tagline: Kanchenjunga views, tea gardens and the toy train
getting_there: Fly to Bagdogra or take a train to New Jalpaiguri (NJP), then about 3 hours by shared jeep or cab.
getting_around: Shared jeeps are cheap. The Mall and Chowrasta are pedestrian-only.

hotel_areas.note: Steep climbs from the taxi stand.

tips: For Tiger Hill sunrise, book the jeep the night before and leave around 4 am.
Kanchenjunga is clearest from October to December. Clouds can hide it on other days.
The Himalayan Mountaineering Institute and the zoo are closed on Thursdays.
Book toy train joy rides in advance. They sell out in season.
Landslides can block roads in the monsoon. Keep a buffer day.
dont_miss: Sunrise on Kanchenjunga from Tiger Hill
A toy train ride around Batasia Loop
First-flush tea at a tea estate
Momos and thukpa on a cold evening

attractions.name: Tiger Hill Sunrise
attractions.description: Watch the first light hit Kanchenjunga, with Everest visible on clear days.

attractions.name: Batasia Loop & War Memorial
attractions.description: A spiral rail loop with gardens and mountain views.

attractions.name: Ghoom Monastery
attractions.description: A 19th-century Tibetan Buddhist monastery with a large Maitreya Buddha.

attractions.name: Toy Train Joy Ride
attractions.description: A ride on the UNESCO-listed Darjeeling Himalayan Railway to Ghoom and back.

attractions.name: HMI & Himalayan Zoo
attractions.description: Everest museum plus red pandas and snow leopards at the zoo next door.

attractions.name: Happy Valley Tea Estate
attractions.description: Walk the tea slopes and see how Darjeeling tea is processed.

attractions.name: Chowrasta & the Mall
attractions.description: The town square for evening walks, old bakeries and woollens.

attractions.name: Japanese Peace Pagoda
attractions.description: White stupa with calm grounds and valley views.

attractions.name: Passenger Ropeway
attractions.description: Cable car down over the tea gardens of the Rangeet valley.

attractions.name: Rock Garden
attractions.description: Terraced garden with a waterfall, down a steep winding road.

transport.bus_note: From Siliguri/NJP, shared jeeps go up to Darjeeling in about 3 hours.

name: Munnar
tagline: Rolling tea hills, mist and wildlife
getting_there: Nearest airport is Kochi (about 4 hours by road). Nearest railway station is Aluva or Ernakulam.
getting_around: Hire a cab for the day. The roads are winding, so plan sights by direction.

hotel_areas.best_for: Budget stays, central for all sights

tips: Eravikulam National Park usually closes in February–March for the Nilgiri tahr calving season. Book tickets online when it's open.
Sightsee in the morning. Mist and rain often roll in by afternoon.
If you see wild elephants on the road, stay inside the vehicle and keep your distance.
Carry motion-sickness tablets if winding roads bother you.
Plastic is restricted in many areas. Carry a reusable bottle.
dont_miss: Nilgiri tahr at Eravikulam
A sunrise jeep ride to Kolukkumalai
Fresh cardamom tea at a roadside stall
Homemade Munnar chocolates

attractions.name: Eravikulam National Park
attractions.description: Grassland hills, home to the endangered Nilgiri tahr.

attractions.name: Tea Museum
attractions.description: See Munnar's tea history and a live processing demo.

attractions.name: Mattupetty Dam
attractions.description: A reservoir with boating, surrounded by hills.

attractions.name: Echo Point
attractions.description: Lakeside spot known for its natural echo.

attractions.name: Top Station
attractions.description: The highest viewpoint near Munnar, looking down into Tamil Nadu.

attractions.name: Attukal Waterfalls
attractions.description: Waterfall between hills, at its best after the monsoon.

attractions.name: Lockhart Gap Viewpoint
attractions.description: Sweeping views of tea estates along the Kochi–Dhanushkodi highway.

attractions.name: Kolukkumalai Sunrise
attractions.description: Off-road jeep ride up to one of the highest tea estates for sunrise.

attractions.name: Kathakali Show
attractions.description: Kerala's classical dance-drama, often with a make-up demo before the show.

name: Udaipur
getting_there: Maharana Pratap Airport, or trains to Udaipur City.
getting_around: Walk the old city and ghats. Use autos for Sajjangarh and Fateh Sagar.

hotel_areas.best_for: Lake-view guesthouses in the old city

hotel_areas.note: Need an auto for the old city.

tips: Sunset boat rides on Lake Pichola sell out on weekends. Book in the afternoon.
Reach the Bagore ki Haveli dance show about 30 minutes early for good seats.
Old city lanes are narrow. Walking or autos are easier than cars.
Dress modestly at Jagdish Temple.
Bargain for miniature paintings and textiles.
dont_miss: Sunset on Lake Pichola
The folk dance show at Bagore ki Haveli
Evening view from Ambrai Ghat
A rooftop dinner looking at the lake

attractions.name: City Palace
attractions.description: A huge palace complex on the banks of Lake Pichola.

attractions.name: Lake Pichola Boat Ride
attractions.description: Boat past the Lake Palace and Jag Mandir at sunset.

attractions.name: Jagdish Temple
attractions.description: Carved 17th-century Vishnu temple near the palace.

attractions.name: Bagore ki Haveli Dance Show
attractions.description: An hour of Rajasthani folk dance and puppetry in an old haveli.

attractions.name: Ambrai Ghat
attractions.description: Ghat with the best view of the lit-up City Palace.

attractions.name: Sajjangarh Monsoon Palace
attractions.description: Hilltop palace with views across the lakes and Aravallis.

attractions.name: Fateh Sagar Lake
attractions.description: Lakeside promenade with snacks, boating and a local crowd.

attractions.name: Saheliyon ki Bari
attractions.description: Garden of the maidens, with fountains and marble elephants.

attractions.name: Hathi Pol Bazaar
attractions.description: Market for miniature paintings, mojaris and textiles.

attractions.name: Kumbhalgarh Fort
attractions.description: A hill fort with walls over 30 km long, about 2.5 hours from the city.

name: Hampi
tagline: Boulder hills and the ruins of Vijayanagara
getting_there: Train to Hosapete, then 13 km by auto or bus. Nearest airports are Hubballi and Bengaluru.
getting_around: Rent a bicycle or scooter, or hire an auto for the day. Some ruins are only reachable on foot.

hotel_areas.best_for: Closest to the ruins, basic guesthouses

hotel_areas.note: Boats stop at dusk and in high water.

tips: Keep your Vittala Temple ticket. It is usually valid the same day for the Lotus Mahal area too.
River crossings stop at dusk and when the water is high. Plan your return.
It's rocky and hot. Carry water, a cap and sunscreen, and wear good shoes.
Remove footwear inside temples.
Don't climb on the monuments or carved pillars.
dont_miss: The stone chariot at Vittala Temple
Sunset from Hemakuta Hill
A coracle ride on the Tungabhadra
Sunrise climb up Matanga Hill

attractions.name: Virupaksha Temple
attractions.description: A living temple from the 7th century with a tall gopuram.

attractions.name: Vittala Temple & Stone Chariot
attractions.description: Hampi's most famous temple with musical pillars and the stone chariot.

attractions.name: Hemakuta Hill Sunset
attractions.description: Small temples on a rocky hill, perfect for the sunset.

attractions.name: Matanga Hill Sunrise
attractions.description: A short steep climb for a 360° view of the ruins at dawn.

attractions.name: Royal Enclosure & Stepped Tank
attractions.description: Mahanavami platform, carved panels and a geometric stepped tank.

attractions.name: Lotus Mahal & Elephant Stables
attractions.description: Indo-Islamic pavilion and the long domed stables for royal elephants.

attractions.name: Queen's Bath
attractions.description: A royal bathing hall with arched corridors.

attractions.name: Hampi Bazaar Street
attractions.description: The old chariot street lined with ruined pavilions and small shops.

attractions.name: Coracle Ride
attractions.description: Float on the river in a round bamboo basket boat.

attractions.name: Anjanadri Hill
attractions.description: About 570 steps up to the Hanuman temple, with huge views.

airport.name: Hubballi
airport.note: Bengaluru (BLR) has far more flights but is about 340 km away.
